name: unread
gloss: nothing reads after the link what it writes, and the link answers alike whatever stands in for it

name: carrier_own
gloss: the link is the carrier's own, the thread's index, the case's index, the bound or an address, and moves the case every thread reads

name: unchanged
gloss: the stand-in writes the link as it stood, and the link is no ask

name: unassembled
gloss: the chain with the stand-in in the link's place does not assemble

name: steered_off
gloss: the link stands past a falsy band past the first case apart, and the steer leaves it and every farther link

name: shape_read
gloss: past the first case apart, the form reads at the link in a shape a link read before it, and the link is no branch of its own

name: alike
gloss: the part answers the stand-in alike with the host on every case it computes

name: apart
gloss: the part answers the stand-in apart from the host at a case

name: refused
gloss: the part refuses the stand-in, leaves it nothing, or the gate holds it

name: const_stop
gloss: the put of a const load and a plain one stops at its first link alike, its question open

name: parameter_unbound
gloss: a parameter of the stand-in has no argument the form gives it, and the put is a malformed question

name: unwritable
gloss: the ruleset writes no stand-in of the arguments the form gives it, and the put is a malformed question

name: no_link
gloss: the form stands at no link of any carrier, and its line carries no link

name: lower
gloss: both forms of a pair whose puts asked nothing stand at a link of a third form, and the part's answers to the two are held against each other, alike or apart between them
